_comment: SEO Index-Worthiness Engine policy. This file IS the 'administration' — RelicsOfWar has no admin UI; edit here, commit, the nightly build applies it. See docs/SEO-INDEX-QUALITY-REQUIREMENTS.md §3–§6 and docs/ARCHITECTURE.md.

thresholds._comment: score >= index → INDEX; reviewBand <= score < index → INDEX only if the page has verified editorial content or price intelligence (unique value), else NOINDEX; noindex <= score < reviewBand → NOINDEX; below noindex → NOINDEX, and not generated at all when the page would also be empty.

weights._comment: Maximum contribution of each factor. Positive factors sum to 100; risks subtract.

inventory._comment: Active-listing counts for era × category market pages. thinItems: below this a page is thin (risk applied). minItemsForIndex: below this INDEX is never awarded regardless of score. cardsPerPage/maxPages bound the crawlable pagination; beyond maxPages the page hands off to ArtifactSearch.

priceGuide._comment: Recorded-sale counts for era × category price-guide pages. Never imply more precision than the data supports: below minSalesToGenerate no page exists; below minSalesToIndex/minSourcesToIndex the page exists for visitors but is NOINDEX.

duplicate._comment: Two generated pages whose listing sets overlap at or above this Jaccard similarity are a duplicate cluster; only the largest is eligible for INDEX, the rest canonicalize to it (CANONICAL_TO_PARENT).

itemPages._comment: Phase 1: RelicsOfWar generates NO per-listing pages. A mirrored listing is canonical on ArtifactSearch (§7–§8); a research-enhanced item page (§9) is a later phase and will require verified editorial content to be generated at all.

growthGate._comment: §13 / §51. The build refuses to publish when the INDEXable URL count grows by more than BOTH limits versus the last committed state, unless SEO_INDEX_EXPANSION_APPROVED=<new count> is set. hardCap is an absolute ceiling regardless of approval.

indexnow._comment: §26–§27. Only URLs whose meaningful content hash changed (or that were added/removed from the INDEX set) are submitted, at most maxUrlsPerRun per build. The key is public by design (served at /<key>.txt).
